title: ConsistencyCheckSet
description: Declarative definitions of the level cross-checks the engine runs. ADR-0003 is enforced here, in the schema itself, so a forbidden check cannot be written down at all: equality is only legal between two observations of the same structural basis (`SL` to `SL`, `FL` to `FL`, `FLOOR_HEIGHT` to `FLOOR_HEIGHT`), and any check that touches the ceiling height `CH` must be an inequality. A definition such as `{left_kind: CH, right_kind: SL, operator: EQ}` fails validation, which is what makes the rule impossible to reintroduce by hand, by a rule author, or by code generation.

operator.title: ConsistencyOperator
operator.description: `EQ` holds when `|left + left_offset_mm - right| <= tolerance_mm`. The inequalities compare `left + left_offset_mm` against `right` and treat `tolerance_mm` as slack in the permissive direction.

check.title: ConsistencyCheck
check.description: One check definition, constrained by the two ADR-0003 height rules.

id.description: Stable identifier of the check, referenced by findings and by the review UI.

tolerance_mm.description: Allowed slack in millimetres. ADR-0003 uses 5mm for structural level equality.

left_offset_mm.description: Constant added to the left value before comparing, so ADR-0003's `CH + slab thickness + floor finish thickness < FLOOR_HEIGHT` can be written as a single check.

message_key.description: i18n key for the finding text (CLAUDE.md rule 8). UI strings never appear here.

height_rules.title: HeightComparisonRules
height_rules.description: The two ADR-0003 constraints, expressed with `if` / `then` / `not`. Carries no fields of its own.

allOf.$comment: ADR-0003 rule 1. Equality is only meaningful between two readings of the same basis, so EQ forces left_kind and right_kind to be the same member of {SL, FL, FLOOR_HEIGHT}. CH is deliberately absent: a ceiling height read from a level table and one read from a finish schedule are compared with an inequality band, never with EQ.
ADR-0003 rule 2, stated from the other direction so the intent survives any future widening of the operator enum: a check with CH on either side must not be an equality.
